name: Wild Tengu (Tengu Variant)
body:
You may have a little dire corby in your family tree, as you are wild and full of fury compared to most tengu. You have jet black, oily feathers, piercing red eyes, and your hands and feet end in vicious talons.

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +4 Dex, –2 Int, –2 Wis, –2 Cha. This trait alters ability scores.
Languages You begin play speaking Common and Tengu. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Auran, Elven, Goblin, and Sylvan. This trait alters languages.
Claw Attacks You have learned to use your claws as natural weapons. You gain two claw attacks as primary natural attacks that deal 1d3 points of damage, and you are treated as having the Improved Unarmed Strike feat for the purpose of qualifying for other feats. This trait replaces swordtrained.
Climb You have a climb speed of 20 feet, and gain the +8 species bonus on Climb checks that a climb speed normally grants. This trait replaces gifted linguist.
Alternate Species Traits
Sharp-Toothed In addition to a beak, your mouth also features a number of vicious, pointed teeth like those of a predatory animal. Your bite deals 1d4 damage and gains a critical modifier of ×3. This trait replaces natural linguist.
Stormborn (Su) You have a mystical connection to the spirits of the thunder and wind. You gain electricity resistance 5, and you ignore concealment due to rain, fog, or smoke. This trait replaces natural linguist.
Species Feats
Long-Nosed Form

You have a secondary, human-like form.

Prerequisite(s): Tengu.

Benefit: You can transform into a specific, curious-looking human form, or back again, as a standard action. You can remain in your human form indefinitely. This form is the same age and body type as your tengu form and has roughly analogous physical traits, such as height, though your nose remains as long as your beak and your complexion has a reddish hue, no matter your skin color. This counts as being disguised as a human, although you gain no bonus to your Disguise check—the imperfections in your transformation are readily obvious to anyone who observes you (although you may be able to hide or explain them). You lose your bite attack while transformed into human form.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
